描述_EN: the figure stands on a formal lotus pedestal and wears a close-fitting robe. the hair is coiled. a beaded ornament reaches down to the ground from the neck. a scarf passes round the neck and over the right arm. a bird rests on the back of the right arm and a vessel is in the left hand.
描述_ZN: 人物站在一个正式的莲花座上，穿着贴身的长袍。 头发是盘起来的。 一个珠饰从颈部伸向地面。 一条围巾绕过颈部和右臂。 一只鸟放在右臂的背面，左手拿着一个容器。
